sn14.38:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Catasso imā bhikkhave dhātuyo || || Katamā catasso || || Pathavīdhātu || āpodhātu || tejodhātu || vāyodhātu || || Ye hi keci bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā imāsaṃ catunnaṃ dhātunaṃ samudayañ ca atthagamān ca assādañ ca ādīnavañ ca nissaraṇañ ca yathābhūtaṃ na pajānantī ti vitthāretabbam || Pajānanti || pe|| sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharantīti || || Navamaṃ || ||
